note: Example contract only; implement or adapt components that the current screens require. Existing library APIs take precedence.

components.name: UiButton
components.responsibility: Trigger one explicit user action without side effects from rendering
components.a11y: Use button element and semantic type; announce loading, prevent double submission, maintain keyboard focus

components.name: UiIconButton
components.responsibility: Compact icon action with an accessible name
components.a11y: Must have a meaningful accessible name; tooltips do not replace aria-label

components.name: UiField
components.responsibility: Label, hint, input slot, validation, accessible associations
components.a11y: Native label plus aria-describedby and aria-invalid on errors

components.name: UiPanel
components.responsibility: Standard surface for one coherent information group
components.a11y: Static panel is not clickable; interactive card must use a real link or button

components.name: UiDialog
components.responsibility: Modal decision or input without inaccessible custom focus handling
components.a11y: Reuse accessible dialog primitive; focus trap, return focus, Escape and labelled dialog

components.name: UiNavItem
components.responsibility: Navigate while making active and keyboard focus states clear
components.a11y: Use links for navigation, aria-current on active target; do not use div click handlers

components.name: UiPageHeader
components.responsibility: Task-oriented page header with one semantic title, optional incremental explanation, real breadcrumb navigation and contextual actions; never generates decorative eyebrow or generic hero copy by default
components.a11y: Use a semantic heading level appropriate to document structure; breadcrumb is nav not decorative label; maintain predictable reading and tab order; avoid duplicate document H1

components.name: UiStatusBadge
components.responsibility: Display semantic state, not arbitrary accent colors
components.a11y: Color never the only signal; include a meaningful label or icon with accessible text

components.name: UiFeedback
components.responsibility: Represent loading, empty, error and success feedback without inconsistent ad hoc screens
components.a11y: Status uses proper live region when necessary; retry actions are descriptive
